data_fields.name: stepScreenVectorPx
data_fields.donor_constant: per direction, e.g. West (-64, 0), South (0, 32) at full progress

data_fields.name: commitAtLastAnimationFrame
data_fields.donor_constant: last frame of the walk animation (rule, no number)

best_idea: Anchor the camera on the last committed position and glide it with the step's animation progress, so the view moves between two confirmed positions and snaps onto the new one at commit.
decision_why: The anchor-on-commit plus glide-by-progress shape gives Frankendom a smooth step between server-confirmed positions, but the donor is a 2D tile game with a fixed step table, so Frankendom needs a continuous lerp driven by the server commit event, and the licence is restricted so only the shape transfers.
acceptance: While the hero steps, the world camera glides from the previous confirmed position to the new one over one step's duration and snaps onto the confirmed position on the frame the commit lands; a client test asserts the camera anchor equals the last committed position at every commit and the glide offset is zero at commit.
